title: Edit SVG points
description: Drag points and curve handles. Each completed edit is undoable.
roundHint: Select a straight corner to round its adjacent edges.
failed: This path could not be edited.
complex: This path has too many points to edit (maximum 4096).
minimum: Keep at least three points for a closed contour, or two for an open path.
hint: Arrow keys move the selected point. Shift moves by 10. Escape cancels a drag.
morphHint: An authored morph controls this outline. Remove its Morph effect before editing source points.
